{{Citation}}
[[File:ShadowRaptorBlackHole-AoRGMK.png|thumb|250px|Space debris falling into a black hole]]

{{Quote|If it's any consolation, nobody knows exactly what you feel when you cross the singularity of a black hole. It might be extremely painful when every atom in your body collapses into neutrons. And since time virtually stops, it could last a really long time.''"<br />"''You're trying to cheer me up.|[[Uldir Lochett]] and [[Leaft]] after learning their ship was approaching a black hole|<ref name="Emissary of the Void">"[[Emissary of the Void]]"</ref>}}
A '''black hole''' was an astrophysical phenomenon with [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of sufficient strength that it prevented even light from escaping.<ref name="Emissary of the Void" /> Black holes were designated class P [[Star/Legends|stars]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:BlackHole-SWREP36.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Several Republic frigates fall into a black hole]]
Black holes typically resulted from the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] of extremely large stars (typically supergiants), which resulted in matter so heavy that it could push into the fabric of space, though some were thought to have been created in the initial moments of the formation of the universe. One section of the black hole was known as the [[Roche Lobe]].

==History==
Black holes were common in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], particularly in a cluster known as [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]]. One existed in the center of the galaxy, and one was also located along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], near [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Their intense gravity, combined with the difficulty in detecting them (as they emitted no light) and the fact that smaller black holes could "wander" through space, made them dangerous navigational hazards which snarled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]]; hundreds of vessels were believed to be lost every standard year, and the effects of an object in hyperspace or realspace colliding with one were the stuff of every spacefarer's nightmare. Unidentified black holes were marked as [[Gamma Class navigation hazard]]s.

Black holes were used throughout much of the galaxy's history as sources of energy. Subatomic knots of space-time were created in encompassing [[Unmanned energy refinery|unmanned energy refineries]], and were an integral part in the function of all manner of gravitational devices.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Artificial black holes==
Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Arakkus]] once simulated the effect of a black hole. He utilized a [[negatron impact charge]] on a dwarf star, causing it to collapse on itself. The resulting [[collapsed dwarf star]] slowly sucked in its surroundings.<ref name="Deadly Reunion">"[[Deadly Reunion]]"</ref>

The [[dovin basal]]s of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] could generate small black holes, which they used as shields. By creating the black hole between a ship and enemy weapons fire, the hole could absorb the incoming fire, which was later dispersed harmlessly as low-intensity [[Gamma ray/Legends|gamma]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] when the black hole would evaporate.

A gravity well projector could also create a black hole. An unstable gravity well projector once collapsed into a black hole and consumed the ship [[Elusive (transport)|''Elusive'']].<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">{{WEGCite|story=Scavenger Hunt (scenario)|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>
